324:t_011:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Phew... Looks like we can finally catch our breath.」

324:t_011:8.en:
$$スズネ$$
「By the way, who is piloting that pink AT?」

324:t_011:9.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I am $$テイタニア・ダ・モンテ＝ウェルズ$$. Though I have cast aside the $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ name.」

324:t_011:10.en:
$$スザク$$
「A $$マーティアル$$ $$ネクスタント$$...!」

324:t_011:11.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Is this all right, $$キリコ$$?」

324:t_011:15.en:
$n
「She's the one who kidnapped $$フィアナ$$. She must be plotting something...」

324:t_011:16.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$キリコ$$ says it's fine, so it's fine!」

324:t_011:18.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's not for outsiders to complain! If you've got time for that, take out the enemy already!」

324:t_011:21.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「As long as $$マーティアル$$ has made us a target, all we can do is meet them head-on.」

324:t_011:22.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We'll wipe out both the $$黒い稲妻旅団$$ and $$マーティアル$$ in one go!」

324:t_012:0.en:
$$カトル$$
「Both the bandits and $$マーティアル$$ have been confirmed destroyed.」

324:t_012:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That woman, $$テイタニア$$... It seems $$マーティアル$$ is after her.」

324:t_012:2.en:
$n
「So she teamed up with $$キリコ$$, who's being targeted by them in the same way?」

324:t_012:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「I thought you'd grown up a little, but you're hopeless when it comes to a girl's heart, $n.」

324:t_012:6.en:
$n
「A girl's heart... Is that something you should be saying?」

324:t_012:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「That attitude is exactly the problem, I'm telling you!」

324:t_012:9.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「I agree with $$カレン$$ this time. Work on yourself, $n.」

324:t_012:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「With this, the job is cleared. We should be able to scrape together some operating funds for now.」

324:t_012:11.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Hunting bandits for money, huh... Sounds like you've been through a lot.」

324:t_012:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...This too is for the sake of justice.」

324:t_012:13.en:
$$カトル$$
「Sorry, $$ゼロ$$. If I had joined up a little sooner, we might have managed somehow...」

324:t_012:15.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Well, $$カトル$$'s family is rich, after all.」

324:t_012:16.en:
$$ノイン$$
「We got back on our feet with the support of $$カトル$$'s family and the help of the $$マグアナック隊$$.」

324:t_012:18.en:
$n
「It's fine, $$ゼロ$$. We managed to help a town in trouble.」

324:t_012:19.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Let us take this as irony aimed at us, who sought a reward for justice.」

324:t_012:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, return! We'll collect the reward at $$グルフェー$$ and discuss our next move!」

324:t_012:23.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Am I... allowed to stay...?」

324:t_013:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Even now, with the world being taken over by the Empire, there are those who won't give up their own greed, and those who stubbornly hold to their faith...」

324:t_013:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I suppose this too is part of being human...」

324:t_013:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Hey, no time to get sentimental. This time we have to ride along on a fight between bad guys wiping each other out.」

324:t_014:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
(There are still enemies... The fighting isn't over yet...)

324:t_014:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Will this cycle go on forever...?)

324:t_100:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
(That presence clinging to me... What do they want...?)

324:t_101:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(Even without my auxiliary brain, stripped of my power as a $$ネクスタント$$, I can still fight.)

324:t_101:1.en:
$$テイタニア$$
($$キリコ$$... I won't let you die.)

324:t_102:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(The feelings $$フィアナ$$ entrusted to me... And my own feelings...)

324:t_102:1.en:
$$テイタニア$$
($$キリコ$$... My reason for living lies in you...)

324:t_103:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「Bandits and $$マーティアル$$ are both our enemies...! Let's go, $$ヒイロ$$!」

324:t_103:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Looks like you've shaken it off, $$五飛$$.」

324:t_103:2.en:
$$五飛$$
「I have no doubts now! I dedicate my life to battle... and to the peace beyond it!」

324:t_104:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「...Are you really sure, $$ヒルデ$$? You could've gone with the $$マグアナック隊$$, you know.」

324:t_104:1.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I already told you about that, $$デュオ$$.」

324:t_104:2.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I know a hard fight lies ahead. But I'm a member of $c too, so I'll fight alongside you and the others, $$デュオ$$.」

324:t_104:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「OK. I won't ask about your resolve ever again.」

324:t_104:4.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Let's go, $$ヒルデ$$! Keep up!」

324:t_105:0.en:
$$カトル$$
「Our fight begins again from here.」

324:t_105:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「It's a fresh start. Until peace returns to this planet, our fight has no end.」

324:t_105:2.en:
$$カトル$$
「Let's go, $$トロワ$$. To show our resolve, too.」

324:t_106:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The members of $c who aren't here are surely fighting in their own ways, too.」

324:t_106:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Yes. Let's join up with them and start our counterattack, $$ゼクス$$.」

324:t_106:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「No... Our counterattack begins this very moment.」

324:t_106:3.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Understood, $$ゼクス$$. I will follow you.」

324:t_106:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Let's go, $$ノイン$$! Our fight is not over yet!」

324:t_107:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「S-so it's finally real combat... Can I really handle the role of captain...?!」

324:t_107:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I have no choice but to do it! I am a member of $c, after all!」

324:t_107:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's give it our all... Battle, battle!」
